body.name: Three-letter staircase facet family
body.construction: For \(n=L-1\ge2\) and \(\omega\in\{\mathrm L,\mathrm R,\mathrm D\}^{n-1}\) ending in \(\mathrm D\), initialize \(a_0=c_0=0\); set \(d_j=a_{j-1}+c_{j-1}+1\), update \(a_j=d_j\) for letters \(\mathrm L\) or \(\mathrm D\) and otherwise \(a_j=a_{j-1}\), and update \(c_j=d_j\) for letters \(\mathrm R\) or \(\mathrm D\) and otherwise \(c_j=c_{j-1}\). With \(K=a_{n-1}=c_{n-1}\), emit \(\kappa=K\), \(\beta=(0,-K-1,0)\), \(\alpha_{0j}=-a_j\), \(\alpha_{1j}=d_j\), \(\alpha_{2j}=-c_j\) for \(j<n\), and \(\alpha_{0n},\alpha_{1n},\alpha_{2n}=(-K,2K+1,-K)\).
